summary: Tested all three new features: Advisor tooltip, branded avatars, and Report Preview thumbnail. Backend endpoint /api/reports/branding/preview validated for auth (401), dark & light PNG generation (200 + valid PNG signature), and refresh after branding save/reset. Frontend flows all functional: hint appears on first login, dismiss persists across reload, advisor toggle opens panel & dismisses hint, AI reply avatars use navy brand-mark.png (naturalWidth 890, no broken images), Settings preview image loads on both dark/light toggles, updates with cache-busting t param after save and reset.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview image src uses cache-buster 't' timestamp — good pattern to force reload after branding changes.
Advisor hint uses localStorage key obserra-advisor-hint-<userId> — user-scoped persistence is correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding preview endpoint + Settings preview UI + Advisor hint + branded avatars all verified end-to-end. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_branding_preview.py (4/4 pass). Note: Settings 'Report Branding' has a nested LIVE COVER PREVIEW block with preview-theme-dark/light toggles inside data-testid=report-branding-settings; image src includes ?theme=<dark|light>&t=<timestamp>.
